ask.prompt: r_c of o_c_n wants to be more than friends. What do you do?
ask.prompt_mate: r_c of o_c_n wants to be more than friends, but m_c already has a mate. What do you do?

mates: m_c and r_c of o_c_n are mates now, though no one else can know.
mates_open: m_c and r_c of o_c_n are mates now.
friends: m_c tells r_c of o_c_n that they can only be friends. It's for the best.

apart: m_c and r_c of o_c_n see less and less of each other, until they don't meet at all.

judged_there: c_n hears that o_c_n has punished r_c for taking a mate from another Clan.

end: m_c tells r_c of o_c_n that it has to end. Neither of them looks back.
keep: m_c and r_c of o_c_n won't give each other up, whatever their Clans think of it.

join_in: r_c of o_c_n means to ask c_n to take {PRONOUN/r_c/object} in, to be with m_c.

affair_leave: r_c finds out that m_c has a mate in another Clan, and ends things with {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
affair_stay: r_c finds out that m_c has a mate in another Clan. r_c stays, but something between them has broken.
rumor: At the Gathering, whispers say a o_c_n warrior has been meeting a cat from another Clan.
meet_tooltip: Slip away to meet your mate. Someone might see.
